title: Many UAP sightings off the coast of San Diego
place_text: Off the coast of San Diego, California

tellings.quote: And just where they are, like a lot are off the coast of San Diego.

plain: Many sightings of UAP, short for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs, are said to cluster off the coast of San Diego. The economist Tyler Cowen says this to Michels, remarking on where the reports tend to come from. If true, something keeps showing up in the same stretch of sea and sky.
